scope: Six existing textile identities linked to technique evidence, geography and dated seller discovery; not a completed provenance certification or annual sales series.

traditions.name: Sambalpuri Bandha
traditions.technique_evidence: Yarn tie-dye (Bandha/ikat); specimen cotton warp and weft.
traditions.next_research: Individual maker and piece-level provenance absent.

traditions.name: Bomkai
traditions.production_geography: Sonepur and Boudh are department-listed production centres.
traditions.technique_evidence: Three-shuttle border; extra warp in border and extra weft in body/pallu, using dobby/jacquard/jala.
traditions.next_research: Recover named current makers, piece-level provenance and cooperative routes; comparable sales still pending.

traditions.name: Khandua
traditions.production_geography: Nuapatna / Cuttack; eastern clusters in seller description.
traditions.technique_evidence: Weft yarn is tied and dyed before weaving; IHB distinguishes warp tie-dyed border from weft tie-dyed pallu.
traditions.next_research: Recover named current makers, piece-level provenance and cooperative routes; comparable sales still pending.

traditions.name: Kotpad
traditions.technique_evidence: Saved institutional evidence associates Mirgan weavers with aul-root dyes.
traditions.next_research: Named maker, current product and detailed dye process remain pending.

traditions.name: Habaspuri
traditions.technique_evidence: Extra-warp temple motifs along border; extra-weft pallu motifs; pit/frame loom with dobby.
traditions.next_research: Recover named current makers, piece-level provenance and cooperative routes; comparable sales still pending.

traditions.name: Berhampuri Patta
traditions.technique_evidence: Silk textile with kumbha/phoda motifs; joda identified as men’s textile, not bangles. Loom construction still needs stronger evidence.
traditions.next_research: Recover piece-level maker attribution and cooperative route; preserve tradition versus individual specimen. Berhampuri loom construction remains open.
traditions.technique_locator: Ghose PDF p.67; conflicting tourism Joda paragraph
